_doc: Hard-coded history for the Parliament annexures (/reports/parliament): every completed FY of Report_format/work/HisParlia_Annexures.xlsx, built by scripts/build_parl_annexures_history.py. A FY present here is shown as written; a later FY is computed from the DB. Units: '000 T; techno: T/CuM/day, Kg/thm, Gcal/tcs. null = blank / '-' in the workbook. reference_periods holds the workbook's own current-period figures, which the report compares with the DB (deviations).

production_performance.note:
Note: * Capacity for FY 2021-22 and FY 2022-23 is based on  current operating capacity as per CHM  office correspondence to MoS and presentation to HSM
